jurisdiction_name: NO COLLEGE HILL WARD 3 (NORTH COLLEGE HILL City)
narrative: No College Hill Ward 3 (City of North College Hill) has 1,309 registered voters, with 66.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 7.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 26.4%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 19.3 percentage points.
